jobs.title: Director, Finance (CSM)
jobs.description:
Job Description

Title:
Director, Finance (CSM)

Id:
21596

Type:
FullTime

Location:
Bolton, ON

At Husky TechnologiesTM, our success is based on your success. Our ability to keep our customers in the lead is based on building the strongest team possible.

Husky TechnologiesTM has a strong foundation built on innovation, close customer relationships and a unique culture and values. We are dedicated to offering our customers the highest quality products and services and are looking for people with the inspiration and talent to develop with us as we pursue our ambitious growth strategy. We are a leader in developing state-of-the-art technology and it is this technology base that uniquely positions us to serve customers who seek differentiation through solutions that provide speed, flexibility and maximum productivity. This capability is at the core of our mission and competitive strategy.

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a wealth of opportunity for personal growth and development. Most importantly, Husky Technologies TM offers an opportunity to work with – and be challenged by – a team of great people. Our success is possible because of the creativity, intelligence and passion of our people around the world and their desire to lead change. At the same time, we are not afraid to expect a lot and strive for leadership in all of our key markets. We are a company taking on new challenges and for the right people this means exceptional career development opportunities, the chance to be part of a team that is the best in the world at what we do and the experience that comes from working in an environment that demands constant transformation and innovation.

Husky TechnologiesTM is an exciting company with tremendous potential. We have a great team and great expectations. If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

The Finance Director serves as a strategic business partner to the Leadership Team in support of Husky’s Global Service Business and Customer Success Management strategy. This role provides leadership for financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, governance, and decision support to drive profitable growth, improve operational performance, and strengthen financial visibility across service revenue streams, including field service, contracts, parts, and other aftermarket offerings. The Finance Director is expected to influence strategic decisions, lead transformation initiatives, and build a high-performing finance capability that enables the business to scale effectively.

Key Responsibilities

Financial Planning & Forecasting

Lead the annual budget, quarterly forecast, and long-range planning processes for the service business.
Develop robust revenue, margin, cost, and headcount forecasts based on operational and commercial drivers.
Translate business strategies into financial plans with clear assumptions, risks, and opportunities.
Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis for service growth, pricing, labor utilization, and investment decisions.

Performance Management & Analysis

Deliver timely and accurate monthly financial reporting and variance analysis for service revenue, gross margin, SG&A, and operating income.
Analyze business performance by region, product line, customer segment, channel, and service offering.
Monitor and explain key drivers of performance, including labor utilization, absorption, contract profitability, attach rates, response times, and service productivity.
Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve growth, profitability, and working capital performance.

Business Partnering

Serve as the senior finance partner to service leadership, operations, commercial teams, and Customer Success leaders, providing insight and challenge on strategic priorities, business performance, and investment decisions.
Lead financial evaluation of pricing strategies, contract renewals, service program design, and capital or operating investments to support sustainable growth and margin expansion.
Provide proactive challenge and decision support to business leaders by identifying risks, opportunities, and trade-offs across growth, productivity, service delivery, and resource allocation.
Lead cross-functional evaluation of new service offerings, business models, and transformation initiatives that improve service coverage, utilization, fulfillment, cost efficiency, and customer value.
Sponsor finance and business transformation initiatives across Finance and Customer Success Management, including enhancements to processes, reporting, operating metrics, and decision frameworks that support growth, profitability, and scalability.

Management Reporting & KPI Development

Develop and enhance dashboards, reporting tools, and KPIs that improve transparency and decision-making.
Standardize definitions and reporting for critical service metrics across the organization.
Improve reporting automation and self-service analytics capabilities where possible.
Present clear financial results and business insights to senior leadership

Process Improvement & Governance

Strengthen forecasting accuracy, reporting discipline, and financial controls within the service business.
Drive continuous improvement in FP&A processes, planning models, and reporting frameworks.
Ensure alignment with corporate finance requirements, accounting policies, and internal controls
Support month-end close and planning processes in partnership with accounting and finance teams.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field required.
CPA, CMA, CFA, or MBA preferred.
10+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, finance business partnering, commercial finance, or operational finance, including leadership responsibility.
Experience in a service, aftermarket, field service, maintenance, or contract-based business strongly preferred.
Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis skills.
Advanced proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP and planning/reporting systems.
Executive presence with strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, and the ability to influence senior leaders across functions and regions.
Proven ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment

Preferred Experience In a Service Business

Understanding of service revenue models such as time and materials, service contracts, preventive maintenance, subscriptions, and parts/service bundles.
Experience analyzing operational KPIs such as technician utilization, service efficiency, contract margins, backlog, renewal rates, and service attach rates.
Familiarity with pricing strategy, labor productivity, installed base analytics, and customer lifecycle economics

Core Competencies

Strategic leadership
Financial and commercial acumen
Analytical rigor
Executive business partnership
Influence and executive communication
Problem solving
Process improvement
Results orientation and a bias for action

Team Development

Build and lead a high-performing finance team with strong capability in financial analysis, strategic thinking, business partnership, and change leadership.
Lead, coach, and develop team members, including succession planning, capability building, and development of future finance leaders.

Financial Leadership

Provide consistent, timely, accurate, and decision-oriented financial reporting for the service business, with greater automation and self-service access to insights where possible

Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. We are committed to equal employment opportunity and respect, value and welcome diversity in our workplace. Husky Technologies TM also values being a great place to work and strives to maintain a safe workplace. Accordingly, Husky TechnologiesTM conditions all offers of employment on satisfactory completion of background checks.

Husky TechnologiesTM is committed to developing inclusive, barrier-free selection processes and work environments. If contacted in relation to a job opportunity or testing, you should advise the member of the Talent Acquisition team in a timely fashion of any disabilities that requires accommodation measures in order to enable you to be assessed in a fair and equitable manner.

Information received relating to accommodation measures will be addressed confidentially.

No agency or telephone inquiries please.

jobs.title: Power and Energy Infrastructure Project Finance, Managing Director (Toronto)
Vice President, Enterprise Platforms
jobs.description:
The Klick Group
—comprising Klick Health (including Klick Katalyst and btwelve), Klick Media Group, Klick Applied Sciences (including Klick Labs), Klick Consulting, and Klick Ventures—is an ecosystem dedicated to realizing the full potential of our people and clients in life sciences. Founded in 1997, we have offices in New York, Philadelphia, Saratoga Springs, Toronto, London, São Paulo, and Singapore. Consistently named a Best Managed Company, Most Admired Corporate Culture, and Great Place to Work, Klick is committed to fostering a high-performance, people-first culture with creativity, collaboration, innovation, and impact across everything we do.

About Our Technology Craft

Our Technology Craft powers Klick’s innovation through platforms, products, and emerging technologies. This craft enables scale, efficiency, and experimentation across the business. Technology teams transform ideas into functional, future-ready solutions. Their work supports both client delivery and internal growth.

Job Description

The Vice President, Enterprise Platforms leads enterprise architecture, client solutioning, and pre-sales strategy for pharmaceutical and life sciences organizations. This role bridges sales opportunity ownership with hands-on technical leadership, shaping complex omnichannel ecosystems that drive measurable business impact. The position partners closely with Sales, Strategy, Medical, Media, and Delivery teams to position technology as a differentiator in multi-million-dollar pursuits while establishing scalable architecture standards.

What You’ll Do

Lead enterprise pre-sales strategy, pipeline forecasting, and opportunity management for multi-million-dollar pharmaceutical platform engagements in collaboration with Sales and Account teams.
Facilitate executive discovery workshops and roadmap sessions with senior pharma stakeholders to define CRM, marketing automation, and data architecture strategies.
Design end-to-end omnichannel architectures spanning Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe, Marketo, SFMC, Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, CDPs, APIs, and integration layers.
Produce architecture diagrams, interaction models, data flows, solution specifications, pricing estimates, and SOW documentation aligned to client and delivery requirements.
Establish governance frameworks, architecture standards, and AI-enabled solution patterns while guiding steering committees and mentoring internal architecture teams.

Qualifications

Required:

10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or life sciences technology, consulting, or enterprise sales operations with demonstrated ownership of complex client engagements.
5+ years of hands-on enterprise architecture or solution design experience, including documented architecture diagrams, data models, and technical specifications.
Proven experience leading pre-sales efforts and managing pipeline for multi-million-dollar opportunities, including forecasting and proposal development.
Deep expertise in enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, Veeva, Adobe Experience Cloud, Marketo, SFMC, Snowflake, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable ecosystems.
Demonstrated experience presenting technical strategies and architecture roadmaps to senior client stakeholders and executive steering committees.

Desired:

Comfort and enthusiasm for using AI as a regular part of how work gets done.
Experience applying AI/ML solutions such as next-best-action, personalization models, predictive analytics, or generative AI for content modularization and insight automation.
Formal training or certification in architecture frameworks such as TOGAF, SAFe, or equivalent enterprise methodologies.
Experience establishing architecture governance processes and reference models within regulated industries.

Additional Information

This posting is for an existing vacancy at Klick.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Klick is consciously creating a culture where everyone can thrive and grow in their careers. We believe that our best work comes from our diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We strongly encourage members of historically underrepresented communities to apply, including Black people, Indigenous peoples, and other people of color, people with disabilities, people from gender and sexually diverse communities and people with intersectional identities. We're also committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Should you require any accommodation, please contact us at careers@klick.com and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs and ensure you have a positive experience.

jobs.title: Transfer Pricing - Financial Transactions, Director
jobs.description:
A career within our Transfer Pricing & Customs practice will provide you with the opportunity to help multinational clients navigate complex cross-border tax, trade and financing matters. Our team advises clients on transfer pricing, customs valuation, trade compliance and international tax planning, helping them achieve compliant, commercially sound outcomes aligned with evolving global regulatory expectations. In this role, you will focus on financial transactions transfer pricing, including interest rate analyses, debt capacity, cash pooling, guarantees, hedging, providing services related to documentation, planning and dispute resolution matters. You will primarily support complex intercompany financing projects and collaborate closely with tax, treasury, valuation and legal stakeholders. Driven by curiosity, you are a reliable, contributing member of a team. In our fast-paced environment, you are expected to adapt to working with a variety of clients and team members, each presenting varying challenges and scopes. Every experience is an opportunity to learn and grow. You are expected to take ownership and consistently deliver quality work that drives value for our clients and success as a team. As you navigate through the Firm, you build a brand for yourself, opening doors to more opportunities.

The opportunity

As a Transfer Pricing Director focused on Financial Transactions, you’ll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping clients address complex intercompany financing issues while delivering high-quality client service and practical, supportable recommendations. Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Lead and manage financial transactions transfer pricing projects, including intercompany loan pricing, debt capacity analyses, guarantee fee analyses, cash pooling arrangements and related documentation
Oversee multiple client engagements, ensuring quality and timely delivery
Develop robust economic analyses that consider credit risk, capital markets data, borrower and lender perspectives, and the commercial terms of related-party financing arrangements
Prepare and review technical memoranda, transfer pricing reports and client deliverables that clearly explain methodologies, assumptions, conclusions and supporting evidence
Advise clients on transfer pricing planning, controversy, and audit defence matters involving intercompany financing transactions
Build and grow client relationships by understanding clients’ businesses, treasury policies, financing structures and broader tax objectives
Use financial data, market evidence and technology-enabled tools to develop efficient, defensible and insightful analyses
Explore and embrace emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, and guide the team in incorporating these tools to enhance the quality and efficiency of client service delivery
Collaborate with PwC tax, valuation and international network teams to deliver integrated advice on complex cross-border financing issues
Guide, coach and develop team members by providing clear direction, technical guidance and timely feedback on financial transactions transfer pricing work
Contribute to business development by identifying client needs, supporting proposals and helping market financial transactions transfer pricing services to existing and prospective clients
Uphold the firm’s code of ethics and business conduct

What You’ll Bring

Demonstrated experience in transfer pricing at the Director level, with significant experience advising on financial transactions and intercompany financing arrangements:
Strong knowledge of financial transactions transfer pricing concepts, including arm’s length interest rate setting, credit ratings, credit risk, debt capacity, guarantees, cash pooling and capital structure considerations
The CFA or CPA designation is a strong asset
MBA, MA or advanced degree in Economics, Tax, Finance or Business Administration, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience
Strong research, writing and quantitative analytical skills, with comfort working with detailed financial analysis, capital markets data and technical transfer pricing guidance
Ability to explain complex financial and economic concepts clearly to clients, tax authorities and internal stakeholders
Ability to think creatively, solve complex problems and develop practical, commercially grounded recommendations
Interest in identifying tax and business consulting opportunities and contributing to the growth of financial transactions transfer pricing services
High motivation, initiative and interest in developing yourself and others, with the ability to manage, coach and retain a team of tax professionals

This position ensures continuity and upholds our standards of excellence following the departure of a valued team member.

The salary range for this position is $152,000 - $202,000. The posted salary range represents the expected hiring range for PwC locations in major city centers. Given our national recruiting approach, ranges may vary for positions in other locations. At PwC Canada, base salary is determined by your skills, experience, qualifications and work location. In addition to base salary, eligible employees may have opportunities to participate in variable incentive pay programs which are designed to reward individual and firm-wide achievements.  We are committed to offering competitive compensation and adhering to all relevant pay transparency legislation. During the hiring process, our Talent Acquisition team will provide details about our comprehensive total rewards package. 

Why you’ll love PwC

We’re inspiring and empowering our people to change the world. Powered by the latest technology, you’ll be a part of diverse teams helping public and private clients build trust and deliver sustained outcomes. This meaningful work, and our continuous development environment, will take your career to the next level. We reward your impact, and support your wellbeing, through a competitive compensation package, inclusive benefits and flexibility programs that will help you thrive in work and life. Learn more about our Application Process and Total Rewards Package at: https://jobs-ca.pwc.com/ca/en/life-at-pwc

PwC Canada acknowledges that we work and live across Turtle Island, on the land that is now known as Canada, which are the lands of the ancestral, treaty and unceded territories of the First Nations, Métis and Inuit Peoples. We recognize the systemic racism, colonialism and oppression that Indigenous Peoples have experienced and still go through, and we commit to allyship and solidarity.

We’re committed to providing accommodation throughout the application, interview, and employment process. If you require accommodation to be at your best, please let us know during the application process.

The use of artificial intelligence (AI) in recruiting is just getting started, so we know you have questions about how and why we use it. At certain points during our recruiting process, we rely on AI to improve your experience. This could be during resume review or curating personalized job recommendations, asking you clarifying questions via a chatbot or during our interview scheduling to improve your experience. Our use of AI helps ensure we combat bias by evaluating candidates equally and fairly, without seeing identity information, such as your name, or gender for example). AI also helps us better predict successful hires by reviewing all applicants for a role and the relationship between your skills, experience and likely success at PwC Canada. While AI supports parts of our recruitment process, final hiring decisions always involve human review. For more information about our use and protection of your data, please refer to our Privacy Policy (https://www.pwc.com/ca/en/privacy-policy.html).
